title: Baked Fish Tagine with Tunisian Twist
description: A flavorful and aromatic fish tagine baked to perfection, infused with Tunisian spices. Serve with couscous or crusty bread.

ingredients.name: Fish (4-6 pieces)
ingredients.notes: White fish such as cod or tilapia work well

instructions: Rinse the fish and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the fish with salt, black pepper, Tunisian cumin, and Tunisian coriander.
Heat the Tunisian olive oil in a large baking dish over medium heat.
Add the shattering garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add the fish to the baking dish and cover with the tagine.
Transfer the baking dish to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot with couscous or crusty bread.
